{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-gauge turtleneck: slim fit, hip length, long sleeves, dusty blue #8fa3b8, extra-fine merino wool
Trousers: straight cut, high waist, full length reaching the top of the boot, charcoal #3b3f48, wool-blend flannel
Coat: single-breasted, tailored fit, below the knee, deep navy #22304a, wool-cashmere with a lined interior
Thick socks: mid-calf, heather grey #7a7f88, merino wool blend
Ankle boots: round toe, low block heel, grippy rubber sole, black #1c1a1d, waterproof-treated leather with a warm lining
Scarf: wide and generously long, light blue-grey #b9c4d0, soft wool
Gloves: classic cut, wrist length, black #1c1a1d, leather with a cashmere lining
Hat: close-fitting beanie with a folded cuff, charcoal #4a4d55, wool-cashmere knit
Bag: structured tote, fits the shoulder over the coat, black #1c1a1d, grained leather

This outfit keeps a classic, understated office look while staying properly warm for a 20-minute walk in deep frost and snow. The knit and flannel trousers are neat enough for work, and the long wool-cashmere coat blocks the wind. The boots have a grippy sole for snow and treated leather that handles road salt, and the scarf, gloves and hat protect the areas that get coldest.
